# clavis lease run

<p class="cli-lead">Run a command with dynamic credentials and auto-revoke</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis lease run CONFIG_ID -- COMMAND [ARGS...] [flags]
```

</div>

Issue credentials, run a command with them (`PGHOST`, `PGPORT`,
`PGUSER`, `PGPASSWORD`, `PGDATABASE` for Postgres), then revoke them,
even if the command fails.

## Examples

```sh
clavis lease run 4a1c… -- psql
clavis lease run 4a1c… --ttl 900 -- ./migrate.sh
```

</dl>
